name: Idiyirachi
tagline: Dried, smoked buffalo meat — pounded with spices
description: This is the classic. Buffalo meat is slow-dried, smoked over wood, and pounded with roasted spices until it turns into fine, smoky strands.
It's ready to eat straight from the jar. Have it with rice and kanji, mix it into fried rice, or just snack on it. A little goes a long way.
Made in small batches with coconut oil. No preservatives, no colours.
ingredients: Buffalo meat, coconut oil, chilli, spices, curry leaves, salt
shelfLife: See packed date and use-by date on the label. Refrigerate after opening.
seoDescription: Buy authentic Malabar Idiyirachi online — buffalo meat slow-dried, wood-smoked and pounded with spices. Made in small batches in Kerala, shipped across India.

name: Chicken Idiyirachi
description: The lighter cousin of our classic idiyirachi. Chicken is dried, smoked and shredded fine with roasted spices.
Lower in fat, high in protein, and just as addictive. Great with rice, inside a sandwich, or straight from the jar.
Cooked in 100% coconut oil with no preservatives.
ingredients: Chicken, coconut oil, chilli, spices, curry leaves, salt
shelfLife: See packed date and use-by date on the label. Refrigerate after opening.
seoDescription: Buy Chicken Idiyirachi online — dried, wood-smoked chicken shredded with Kerala spices. Low fat, high protein, no preservatives. Ships across India.

name: Meat Cheenth
tagline: Chunky dried buffalo meat — bold and flavourful
description: Cheenth means torn — buffalo meat pulled into bigger, chunkier pieces than idiyirachi, so every bite is more meaty and more intense.
If you like your dried meat with real texture and a deep smoky kick, this is the one to get.
Made in small batches with coconut oil and roasted spices. Nothing artificial.

Made in small batches. No preservatives — the vinegar and oil do the work.
